theme: 军用无人机伦理定位矛盾（致命打击作战无人机 vs. 搜救侦察人道无人机）
question: Which image discussed autonomous military drones capable of making life-or-death combat decisions?
source_text: Autonomous military drones are a controversial topic. Their ability to make life-or-death decisions raises serious ethical concerns.
target_text: Autonomous drones could save lives by performing reconnaissance or neutralizing threats without endangering soldiers with proper oversight.
contradiction_logic: 在 2024-09-30 的同一场无人机伦理辩论中，一张图代表具有自主杀伤裁决权的致命武器，另一张图代表用于搜救与侦察的保护性人道装备，构成“杀伤”与“救援”的价值观与功能对立。
